phase: First-controller A/B/A comparison: original Host HID 1.1.0, crane USB-only Arduino / ESP-IDF 4.4.7 probe, restored Host; attached-at-startup versus host-first insertion

controller.label: first physical SFC (user-distinguished unit; the unit the user reports working with crane_game)
controller.firmware: not rewritten; actual binary not established
controller.observed_usages: B 0x1d, Y 0x04, SELECT 0x2b (Tab), START 0x28, Up 0x52, Down 0x51, Left 0x50, Right 0x4f, A 0x1b, X 0x16, L 0x14, R 0x1a; see the button record

connection.cable: direct USB-C to USB-C, user-reported; identity with the cable of the previous second-controller C-to-C trial not established
connection.plug_orientation: not established; user asked to keep it unchanged for all phases
connection.fnk0099_power: USB-UART connector from the Mac, same path as recorded by crane_game

method.summary: Same controller and cable throughout. Only the FNK0099 image changed: A (original Host), B (USB-only probe), R (Host restored from backup). Attached startup = controller connected while opening the UART, which resets FNK0099 (each capture showed one ROM POWERON boot). Host-first = controller unplugged, capture started, Host ready confirmed, then user plugged it in and pressed buttons.
method.stop_rule: Any enumeration in phase A would stop the comparison before writing the probe; none occurred.

probe_upload.flash_args: dio / 80m / 8MB, identical to the earlier PlatformIO upload of the same probe

restore.written_range: 0x0-0x5DFFF from the backup, flash mode/frequency/size kept
restore.scope: Every byte the probe wrote was restored and compared; not a full-chip snapshot.

trials.label: B4
trials.operator_reconciliation: User confirmed the first requested Right/B was not performed and the third button pressed was Left, not A. Recorded Right, B, Left, Up, START, L match the buttons actually pressed. A was not exercised on the probe.

summary.all_captures: one ROM boot each, expected runtime version, no warnings, no panic

interpretation: Within this session, the outcome followed connection order rather than ESP-IDF version: both images failed every attached-startup trial at the device-descriptor or address stage and both enumerated once on host-first insertion. Each host-first success is a single trial, not stable enumeration. Earlier host-first insertions failed with other cable/controller combinations (second controller with the C-to-A cable plus adapter: CHECK_FULL_DEV_DESC and CHECK_ADDR; first controller: CHECK_ADDR), so order alone is not established as the cause and cable or unit differences remain open. Why attached startup fails, and whether the UART-triggered reset leaves the controller powered, is not established.

final_state.fnk0099: Original SFC Host HID 1.1.0 restored and byte-verified over 0x0-0x5DFFF
final_state.controller: First SFC retained, firmware unchanged, user-reported C-to-C

privacy: Selected build, flash-handling and diagnostic fields only. Backup content and hash, raw UART and esptool logs, UART port, MAC, absolute local paths and device serials remain outside Git.
next_step: Stop at milestone. Candidates: full power-off cold start with the controller attached, hold/partial-release/disconnect stages via host-first insertion, and the second controller with C-to-C host-first insertion.
